$comment: Static IntelliSense model for delegate fragments (FR-22), hand-maintained against the accessor surface published at docs/src/content/docs/delegates.mdx (### Accessor surface), which is the living record of what a fragment can actually call, and against the engine types it mirrors: fallen-8-core/Model/AGraphElementModel.cs, VertexModel.cs, EdgeModel.cs. Update this file whenever those change. `compilable: false` marks a member that EXISTS on the engine type but whose call fails with CS0012, because the narrow compile does not reference the assembly its signature names; those stay listed as a discovery aid, name their substitute, sort last, and are withheld from the NL-assist prompt. DelegateAccessorSurfaceTest compiles every entry here against the real validator.

members.name: Id
members.doc: The graph element id (unique per instance).

members.name: Label
members.doc: The element's label, or null.

members.name: GetCreationDate
members.doc: The creation timestamp.

members.name: GetModificationDate
members.doc: The last-modification timestamp.

members.name: GetPropertyCount
members.doc: Number of properties on this element.

members.name: GetAllProperties
members.doc: NOT callable in a fragment: fails with CS0012, because ImmutableDictionary<,> lives in System.Collections.Immutable and the compile does not reference it. Use GetPropertyCount(), TryGetProperty(out T, id) or AnyPropertyValueMatches(predicate) instead.

members.name: TryGetProperty
members.signature: bool TryGetProperty<T>(out T result, string propertyId)
members.doc: The canonical typed property access: returns false when the property is missing, not a T, or null - never throws. Example: TryGetProperty(out int age, "age") && age > 30

members.name: AnyPropertyValueMatches
members.doc: Whether any string-typed property VALUE satisfies the predicate (property names never reach it; reserved embedding entries are skipped). Example: AnyPropertyValueMatches(s => s.Contains("Tech", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))

members.name: TryGetEmbedding
members.signature: bool TryGetEmbedding(out ReadOnlySpan<float> vector, string name = "default")
members.doc: The named embedding, if present. The name argument is optional and defaults to "default".

members.name: TryGetEmbeddingModelStamp
members.signature: bool TryGetEmbeddingModelStamp(out string stamp, string name = "default")
members.doc: The model stamp stored next to a provider-written embedding (absent for a bring-your-own vector).

members.name: GetInDegree
members.doc: Count of incoming edges.

members.name: GetOutDegree
members.doc: Count of outgoing edges.

members.name: GetAllNeighbors
members.doc: NOT callable in a fragment: fails with CS0012, because List<> resolves to System.Collections and the compile does not reference it. Walk the adjacency instead, e.g. v.OutEdges != null && v.OutEdges.SelectMany(kv => kv.Value).Any(e => e.TargetVertex.Label == "person").

members.name: GetIncomingEdgeIds
members.doc: NOT callable in a fragment: fails with CS0012, because List<> resolves to System.Collections and the compile does not reference it. Use InEdges.Keys (guard InEdges for null), or TryGetInEdge for one id.

members.name: GetOutgoingEdgeIds
members.doc: NOT callable in a fragment: fails with CS0012, because List<> resolves to System.Collections and the compile does not reference it. Use OutEdges.Keys (guard OutEdges for null), or TryGetOutEdge for one id.

members.name: OutEdges
members.doc: Outgoing edges grouped by edge-property id, or null when the vertex has none in that direction: guard before dereferencing.

members.name: InEdges
members.doc: Incoming edges grouped by edge-property id, or null when the vertex has none in that direction: guard before dereferencing.

members.name: TryGetOutEdge
members.signature: bool TryGetOutEdge(out IReadOnlyList<EdgeModel> result, string edgePropertyId)
members.doc: Outgoing edges for one edge-property id; false with a null result when the group is absent.

members.name: TryGetInEdge
members.signature: bool TryGetInEdge(out IReadOnlyList<EdgeModel> result, string edgePropertyId)
members.doc: Incoming edges for one edge-property id; false with a null result when the group is absent.

members.name: TryGetOutEdgesSpan
members.signature: bool TryGetOutEdgesSpan(out ReadOnlySpan<EdgeModel> edges, string edgePropertyId)
members.doc: The same outgoing group, allocation-free. The span is a ref struct, so iterate it in scope.

members.name: TryGetInEdgesSpan
members.signature: bool TryGetInEdgesSpan(out ReadOnlySpan<EdgeModel> edges, string edgePropertyId)
members.doc: The same incoming group, allocation-free. The span is a ref struct, so iterate it in scope.

members.name: SourceVertex
members.doc: The edge's source vertex (readonly).

members.name: TargetVertex
members.doc: The edge's target vertex (readonly).

members.name: EdgePropertyId
members.doc: The edge-property id this edge belongs to.

members.name: Length
members.doc: String length.

members.name: StartsWith
members.doc: Prefix test.

members.name: EndsWith
members.doc: Suffix test.

members.name: Contains
members.doc: Substring test.

members.name: Equals
members.doc: Equality test.

members.name: ToLower
members.doc: Lower-case copy.

members.name: ToUpper
members.doc: Upper-case copy.

members.name: Trim
members.doc: Whitespace-trimmed copy.

members.name: IndexOf
members.doc: First index of value, or -1.
